name: apollo
description: Connect Apollo to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Apollo MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Apollo to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with b2B contacts and prospecting using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Apollo workspace.
Find anything in Apollo that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review b2B contacts and prospecting in Apollo.
